question: Can you provide a list of hardware product segments along with their unique product counts for 2020 in the output, ordered by the highest percentage increase in unique fact sales products from 2020 to 2021?
sql:
WITH product_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.segment,
    fy.fiscal_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fy.product_code) AS unique_products
  FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly fy
  JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON fy.product_code = p.product_code
  WHERE fy.fiscal_year IN (2020, 2021)
  GROUP BY p.segment, fy.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  segment,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN unique_products END) AS products_2020,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN unique_products END) AS products_2021,
  1.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN unique_products END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN unique_products END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN unique_products END) * 100 AS pct_increase
FROM product_counts
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
